dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct pale/white margins visible on folded secondary and tertial feathers, creating sharp contrast boundaries against the grey feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Rufous/orange-brown elliptical region covering the visible portion of the crown and upper nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear color transition separating the rufous crown from the uniform slate-grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast tail pattern consisting of large, rounded white spots arranged in transverse bands across dark/black rectrices.
